title: Tubulin superpositions decohere far too fast for the brain

statements.text: Tegmark estimated the decoherence time of tubulin superpositions in the brain at less than $10^{-12}$ seconds, much too short against the millisecond scale of microtubule processes, an objection Zizzi takes up for the brain half of her picture.

sources.quote: Influential criticism of the possibility that quantum states can in fact survive long enough in the thermal environment of the brain has been raised by Tegmark
